generations.name: Siemens SD-100
generations.description: The Siemens SD-100 cars formed RTD's original light rail fleet when the Central Corridor opened in 1994. They continue to operate on the RTD light rail network.

generations.name: Siemens SD-160
generations.description: The Siemens SD-160 fleet was acquired for RTD's FasTracks-era light rail expansion, including the Southeast and West corridors.

generations.name: Hyundai Rotem Silverliner V
generations.description: The Hyundai Rotem Silverliner V electric multiple units operate RTD's commuter-rail services, including the A, B, and G Lines. The 66-car fleet was delivered for the Eagle P3 project.
